text: Fix the root cause of four failures and corrections today (jobs 8qkc, m1bs and two hand corrections): a reading's acceptance criteria say 'only these files change' while its deliverables list names other files, or the criteria exclude CHANGELOG.md although this repository adds a CHANGELOG.md entry to every change (BRIEF.md asks for a changelog). The producer follows one, the verifier enforces the other, and the job fails. Make a reading self-consistent before it is shown: a file-scope criterion must agree with the deliverables list, and a contradiction is caught in code when the reading is parsed or admitted, not left to the verifier. Make the changelog entry a default the reader includes rather than something each request must remember.
